list.title: Templates
list.description: Tested image prompts with blanks: fill in a few fields and copy a complete prompt, with the same wording as the version we tested.
list.intro: Each template is a tested prompt with a few blanks. Fill them in and the prompt updates as you type; copy it or download it as a text file.
list.empty: There are no templates in this language yet.

editor.downloaded: Prompt downloaded as a text file
editor.missing: {count, plural, one {# field to fill} other {# fields to fill}}
editor.restored: Restored what you entered last time.
editor.shared: Filled in from a shared link.
editor.mismatch: That link was made for version {version}. Showing the default sample of version {current} instead.

errors.required: {label} is empty. Fill it in to complete the prompt.
errors.too-many: {label} takes at most {limit} items (now {actual}). Remove the extra ones.
errors.item-too-long: Item {item} can't be longer than {limit} characters (now {actual}).
errors.empty-item: Item {item} is empty. Remove it or fill it in.
errors.invalid-option: Choose one of the options for {label}.
errors.wrong-type: This value can't be used for {label}. Enter it again.

tokens.howTo: Press Enter to add an item.
tokens.remaining: {count, plural, one {# more can be added.} other {# more can be added.}}
tokens.full: {max, plural, one {This field takes # item.} other {This field takes # items.}} Remove one to add another.
tokens.pendingTooLong: This item has {count} characters; the limit is {max}.
